title: Gas Sensor Smell Nahi Karta, Phir Bhi Pakad Leta Hai #shorts
description:
Gas leak ki smell aapse pehle machine ko kaise aati hai? Jaaniye MQ-2 sensor ka asli 3D raaz.
🔥 MQ-2 module ka real 3D model
🧪 SnO2 layer aur heater coil andar se
⚡ LM393 aur Arduino se alarm kaise bajta hai
🍳 Kitchen mein gas leak ka use
Aise aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo.
